lines.say: Why is one side of your body stronger than the other?
Why does this happen, number nine.
Most of the time it's not your muscles. It's your brain.
You use your dominant side all day, so your brain gets better at driving it. It fires more muscle, more smoothly.
That's why your weak arm shakes first on dumbbell presses.
The fix: train each side on its own. Start with the weak side, and match the reps on the strong side.
And here's the wild part. Train only one arm, and the other arm gets stronger too. About eight percent in studies.
Because your brain learns the move for both sides.
